patch.value: Official Core 2026.8.1 adds config/device_registry/list_composite_splits, config/device_registry/list_linked_devices, and config/entity_registry/settings/get|update. Deliver typed CLI discovery and guarded admin mutation with deterministic output, explicit pre-2026.8 compatibility, complete docs, exact coverage, live read-only evidence, and release automation proof.
Add Home Assistant 2026.8 registry topology intelligence
Expose the new Home Assistant Core 2026.8 registry topology and entity-ID naming contracts through typed, bounded, format-stable hassio commands.

Typed commands cover composite splits, linked devices, automatic entity-ID previews, and entity-ID settings read/update; Write operations fail locally in read-only mode before WebSocket connection; All global output formats, recursive help, docs, schemas, package behavior, live compatibility, and 100/100/100/100 coverage pass
Official Core 2026.8.1 source and tests inspected; all-status PM and GitHub duplicate searches completed; live Core version recorded without private payloads.
Agents can understand device migration and identity topology without raw WebSocket payload knowledge.
Reduces unsafe device targeting and makes Home Assistant 2026.8 entity naming policy inspectable and automatable.
Production-ready typed registry intelligence with safe mutation boundaries and backward-compatible failure semantics.
These contracts shipped in the current Core 2026.8.1 release and are absent from the CLI while the local 2026.7.4 instance provides a real compatibility boundary.
